reference_resolution.rule: subject and test must each resolve to a repo path, commit sha, or a command actually run — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: overall verdict = the worst-case result across all cited test entries (failed > cantTell > inapplicable > untested > passed), never a standalone summary field asserted independently of the cited results (issue-515 invariant 4).
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

gate_b_contrast: hollow instance: a record where every result entry is untested or cantTell, with no resolvable command output behind assertedBy, is schema-conformant but asserts nothing about the artifact under observation — at least one passed or failed entry, each tied to a command actually run, is required for the record to count as a genuine observation (issue-807 step2 audit).
gate_c_status: N/A — mechanical aggregation, not investigative finding. This role's judgment reduces to applying the worst-case recomputation rule over already-run test claims; it does not decide what to observe. Per issue-807 step1 sec4's N/A test: two independent observers re-running the same test set against the same commit sha produce the same worst-case verdict, so there is no discretionary finding step to ground a lens-based method for.

use_when.board_condition: an executable artifact landed on the branch AND no execution-observation record exists yet for this commit sha
